FC-602-capture-incomplete note claims '657 filing metas, ~232 without a staged primary'. Independently counted the live DAYU_ROOT: 657 reproduces only as ALL meta.json files under portfolio/ (630 filing-group + 27 entity-level = 657), not filing metas alone (441). '~232 without a staged primary' not reproducible under any definition tested: 16 groups with no document file at all, 37 without any .pdf/.htm/.html, 17 with ingest_complete != True, 0 metas lacking a primary_document key, 16 declared primaries missing on disk. The live dayu tree may have changed since the implementer measured (dayu-agent writes into it), which would explain part of the gap, but the number cannot be independently confirmed today. Mechanism itself (meta-before-bytes -> metadata-only groups skipped) is proven by code read, test_fc602_metadata_only_group_skipped, and mutation M2.

The receipt's 'only 1 capture-incomplete (the _download_rejections artifact)' is not reproducible: the live catalog has ZERO rows with location_status='capture_incomplete' (locations table) and no capture_incomplete in documents.source_status; 13 _download_rejections.json locations are currently active with role original_primary (none status-marked capture_incomplete). '221 active dayu docs' verified exact. Descriptive count in the scenario note only; the gating evidence (adapter skips byte-less groups; incomplete filings not reused per test_fc602_incomplete_dayu_not_reused) is unaffected.

The v2 adapter path (scan_root_via_adapter) does NOT receive master_identity or portfolio_urls from scan_root_strategy (scanner.py:1347-1359), so the v1 scanner's Phase 15.4 identity propagation (provider_company_id -> security master org -> market/security_id backfill, scanner.py:532-541) is absent from the adapter.
